id.title: Dormancy configuration identifier
id.description: Dormancy configuration unique identifier generated by Pismo.

check_time.title: Dormancy check time
check_time.description: The dormancy check time in the division's/program's timezone.

target_type.title: Target type
target_type.description: Indicates the type of level to which the dormancy config is attached.

target_id.title: Target ID
target_id.description: Unique ID used to identify the level the dormancy config is attached to in the Pismo platform APIs.

statuses.title: Dormancy configuration status list
statuses.description: List of objects that contains all the information pertinent to valid dormancy statuses.

status.title: Status name
status.description:
It only accepts the following dormancy values:

`INACTIVE`: When the account is inactive.

`DORMANT`: When the account is dormant.

`UNCLAIMED`: When the account is unclaimed.

days.title: Number of days
days.description: Days of inactivity required to transition the account to the specified status. Each value specified must be unique in the status object.

reason_id.title: Reason unique identifier
reason_id.description: The reason associated with the specified status.

reason_external_id.title: Reason external identifier
reason_external_id.description: The external identifier of the reason associated with the specified status.

reactivation_with_last_restriction.title: Reactivation with last restriction
reactivation_with_last_restriction.description: Indicates whether the account should be reactivated to `normal` with its last manual change restriction.

restrictions.title: Restrictions
restrictions.description: List of objects that contain the information pertaining to account dormancy restrictions.

current_reason_id.description: The dormancy configuration checks whether the current account `reason_id` is the same as the current account reason. If they are different, the dormancy configuration sets the reason to the value of the `reason_id` field.

current_reason_external_id.description: The external identifier of the current reason.

new_reason_id.description: The `reason_id` related to that status if the current account `reason_id` value is the same as `current_reason_id`.

new_reason_external_id.description: The external identifier of the new reason.

dormancy_config_validity.title: Dormancy-config validity date
dormancy_config_validity.description: Object for the validity date of the dormancy configuration.

start.title: Dormancy-config validity start date
start.description: The effective date of the configuration in UTC format.

end.title: Dormancy-config validity end date
end.description: The end date of the configuration in UTC format.

dormant_processing_codes.title: Dormant processing code list
dormant_processing_codes.description: List of processing codes that prevent account reactivation. When there are financial transactions in an account that are made with any of these codes, the account cannot be reactivated.

deny_forced_transaction_reactivation.title: Deny Forced Transaction Reactivation
deny_forced_transaction_reactivation.description: Indicates whether an account under that dormancy configuration should be reactivated when a forced transaction is made to that account.

check_timezone_origin.title: Check timezone origin
check_timezone_origin.description: Specify whether the dormancy check uses the timezone of the account’s program or division. If not specified, the timezone of `target_id` is used.

reactivation_exceptions_config.title: Dormancy Reactivation Exception Configuration
reactivation_exceptions_config.description: Specifies configuration rules that allow certain transactions to bypass dormancy reactivation based on defined transaction attributes and their corresponding values.

field.title: Transaction Attribute to Evaluate
field.description: Specifies which transaction attribute is checked in order to determine whether a transaction is exempt from reactivating a dormant account.

values.title: Permitted Attribute Values
values.description: Lists the values that, when present in the specified field, prevent the account from being reactivated by that transaction.
